question: Prepare a comprehensive performance report on our sellers, focusing on total sales, average item price, average review scores, and packing times. Ensure that the report includes only those sellers who have sold a quantity of more than 100 products and highlight the product category names in English with the highest sales volume.
sql:
WITH seller_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        COUNT(*) as total_quantity,
        AVG(oi.price) as avg_item_price,
        AVG(COALESCE(orv.review_score, 0)) as avg_review_score,
        AVG((TRY_CAST(oi.shipping_limit_date AS DATE) - TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE))) as avg_packing_days
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    LEFT JOIN order_reviews orv ON oi.order_id = orv.order_id
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
),
category_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        ptc.product_category_name_english,
        COUNT(*) as total_quantity,
        SUM(oi.price) as total_revenue
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product_category_name_translation ptc ON p.product_category_name = ptc.product_category_name
    GROUP BY ptc.product_category_name_english
)
SELECT 
    sm.seller_id,
    sm.total_quantity,
    sm.avg_item_price,
    sm.avg_review_score,
    sm.avg_packing_days,
    cs.product_category_name_english,
    cs.total_quantity as category_quantity,
    cs.total_revenue as category_revenue
FROM seller_metrics sm
CROSS JOIN (SELECT product_category_name_english, total_quantity, total_revenue FROM category_sales ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 5) cs
ORDER BY sm.total_quantity DESC
